exact_definition: For context h, Delta_E(h)=P_sample(D=d* | R,C=c1,h)-P_sample(D=d* | R,C=c0,h), with d* one exact source-native destination state frozen before target outcomes
destination_semantics_required: Exact destination measurement identity; exact source-native state d*; c1/c0 identities; h is broad or one exact admitted joint predicate
order_or_score_authority: NONE; subtraction compares scalar event probabilities and does not order D's state domain
ttar_requirement: NONE when d* is already a lawful source-native state and no state transform occurs
minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: Exact positive denominators for both c1 and c0 cells plus exact numerator counts under governed unit/risk-set/exposure/state identities
lawful_exact_direction_use: Exact nonzero opposite signs can establish directional REVERSAL; equal nonzero signs can establish DIRECTIONAL_PERSISTENCE; admitted states containing both + and - establish exact DIRECTIONAL_SPLIT
failure_or_abstention: ABSTAIN if either denominator is zero, d* identity is unresolved, or required unit/exposure/state authority is unresolved
ceiling: No population inference, causal direction, materiality, null-equivalence, or magnitude persistence follows

exact_definition: Delta_E(h)=P_sample(E=1 | R,C=c1,h)-P_sample(E=1 | R,C=c0,h), where E is an already source-defined binary event
destination_semantics_required: Exact source-native Boolean event identity and values
ttar_requirement: NONE if Boolean event is source-native
lawful_exact_direction_use: Same exact sign logic as F01
failure_or_abstention: ABSTAIN if Boolean event identity or denominators unresolved
ceiling: Does not authorize recoding a nominal multi-state destination into Boolean form

exact_definition: Delta_E(h)=P_sample(D in S* | R,C=c1,h)-P_sample(D in S* | R,C=c0,h), S* finite and frozen before target outcomes
destination_semantics_required: Exact native state universe plus exact event-set membership S*
order_or_score_authority: NONE merely to evaluate set membership
ttar_requirement: NONE only when S* is a claim predicate over preserved native states and creates no semantic equivalence/collapse; TTAR REQUIRED if the operation asserts a new merged category/equivalence or changes state identity
minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: Same as F01 after S* lawfulness
lawful_exact_direction_use: Same exact sign logic as F01
failure_or_abstention: ABSTAIN if S* lacks claim-semantic authority; UNRESOLVED__NO_EXECUTION if required TTAR is absent
ceiling: Event membership is not permission to treat member states as generally equivalent

exact_definition: Delta_E(h) for E=[D <= d*] or E=[D >= d*] under an already lawful order
destination_semantics_required: Exact destination state identities plus authoritative order and threshold predicate
order_or_score_authority: REQUIRED: source-native order authority or separately competent order authority
ttar_requirement: TTAR REQUIRED when threshold/order is created by a non-native transformation
lawful_exact_direction_use: Exact sign statuses only after order/threshold is frozen
ceiling: No ordinal order may be invented from codes, labels, frequency, or target outcomes

destination_semantics_required: Exact destination identities plus authoritative numeric/cardinal score g
order_or_score_authority: REQUIRED: source-native cardinal measurement or competent scoring authority
ttar_requirement: TTAR/measurement-transform authority REQUIRED if g changes semantic scale
minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: Positive denominators plus exact scored-event facts and replay
lawful_exact_direction_use: Can support exact signed comparison only for the authorized score-defined proposition
ceiling: Never infer numeric spacing from categorical codes

exact_definition: Delta_D(h)=[P_sample(D=d_j|R,C=c1,h)-P_sample(D=d_j|R,C=c0,h)] for every exact native state d_j in frozen order used only for serialization identity
destination_semantics_required: Exact native state universe; no merge, score, or ordinal semantics
order_or_score_authority: NONE; serialization order is not substantive order
minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: Positive denominators for c1 and c0 plus exact per-state counts
result_type: VECTOR_DELTA; componentwise signs permitted but NO_CANONICAL_GLOBAL_SIGN
lawful_exact_direction_use: May support component-specific or preregistered vector relation assertions; cannot by itself emit one global PERSISTENCE/REVERSAL/SPLIT sign status
ceiling: Any scalarization, norm, ordered dominance, or global sign requires separate preregistered authority/functional

exact_definition: REL_VECTOR(Delta_D(broad),Delta_D(within)) under one fully preregistered vector-valued comparison rule
destination_semantics_required: Exact vector domain plus exact relation rule
order_or_score_authority: Only as required by the relation; no implicit order
ttar_requirement: TTAR or other authority required if relation changes semantic equivalence/scale
minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: As required for every vector component consumed
lawful_exact_direction_use: May yield a typed vector persistence/reversal concept only if that exact relation is in the future CIM/CITC
ceiling: No post-output choice of norm, component subset, or scalar summary

minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: Both broad and within contrasts identified
lawful_exact_direction_use: REVERSAL exact at directional sign grain
failure_or_abstention: NOT_REVERSAL when same sign; UNRESOLVED if either sign unavailable
ceiling: Does not mean material, statistically significant, causal, or population-level reversal

failure_or_abstention: ZERO_OR_UNRESOLVED is not silently called persistence
ceiling: Persistence in magnitude or within tolerance remains CITC jurisdiction

exact_definition: Across support-admitted states, at least one lawful Delta_E(s)>0 and at least one lawful Delta_E(s)<0; equivalently for nonzero broad sign, at least one state persists and at least one reverses when those statuses exist
destination_semantics_required: Requires lawful scalar F01-F05 and predeclared admitted-state quantifier/domain
minimum_support_for_exact_realized_sampl: Every state in the frozen candidate domain has typed admitted/abstained status
failure_or_abstention: Do not manufacture split from zero/unresolved states alone
ceiling: Material split, null-equivalence, prevalence weighting, or minimum reversal mass requires CITC/support authority
